submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I relied on the prior that Fe–V oxide phases (FeVO4 / Fe2O3-like) are the photoactive component at 2.4 eV, while Ni-rich and V-rich regions are weak. The two Fe-rich, low-Ni points (28 and 119) each gave 1.8e-7 A. The V-rich point (123) gave 4e-8 A. 28 and 119 tie; I chose 28 (Fe0.53 Ni0.18 V0.29) because it has the lowest Ni and sits closer to the FeVO4-containing region.

rejected.reason: V-rich (V 0.60): measured 4e-8 A, 4.5x lower than the Fe-rich points
Tied at 1.8e-7 A; has more Ni and less V than 28
Not measured. NiO-rich oxides are generally poor photoanodes, and the budget was spent on the Fe-rich region instead
